title: Hyperfold World Schema
description: Schema for a complete world/level collection in Hyperfold, supporting both modular file references and single-file inlined rooms.

description.description: Narrative or gameplay overview for the world

startingCoords.description: Coordinates of the initial entry sector. Defaults to [0, 0].

rooms.description: Either an array of relative file paths to modular room JSON files, or an inlined array of complete room objects.

oneOf.description: Relative path to a room JSON file (e.g. './rooms/room_0_0.json')
